svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron" agent="GitHub Copilot"> <diagram id="reflection-summary" name="Reflection Visual Summary"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="470" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=24;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#18343B;" value="Reflection: critique, revise, or stop" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="800" x="48" y="22" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="draft" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E2F1EE;strokeColor=#76A99E;fontColor=#18343B;fontSize=16;" value="Draft / revision
use critique on retry" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="172" x="48" y="185" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="critique" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E9EDF7;strokeColor=#9AA8C2;fontColor=#18343B;fontSize=16;" value="Critique
compare to criteria" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="180" x="310" y="185" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="check" parent="1" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF0E8;strokeColor=#D99B76;fontColor=#18343B;fontSize=15;" value="Accepted?
Budget remains?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="160" x="570" y="155" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="return" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E2F1EE;strokeColor=#76A99E;fontColor=#18343B;fontSize=16;" value="Accepted output
review passed" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="210" x="840" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="exhausted" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FCE8E7;strokeColor=#D58C86;fontColor=#18343B;fontSize=16;" value="Not accepted
return reviewed draft + gaps" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="210" x="840" y="270" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="draft" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;" target="critique"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="critique" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;" target="check"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="check" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="return" value="Accepted (also on final round)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="check" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="draft" value="Revise only while budget remains"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="650" y="400" /> <mxPoint x="134" y="400" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="check" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="exhausted" value="Rejected + budget exhausted"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
